name: Furlbrow's Pocket Watch
summary: In Westfall, Farmer Furlbrow has lost a keepsake from his wedding day. His pocket watch came from Verna’s father, and it was left behind when Defias bandits seized the family’s pumpkin farm.

sections.title: A Keepsake in the Ruins
sections.body: Farmer Furlbrow and Verna fled their home in the night when Defias bandits swarmed the Furlbrow Pumpkin Patch. In the rush, he left a pocket watch from Verna’s father behind. The watch remains in a wardrobe in the overrun farmhouse, where Benny Blaanco and his cutthroats keep watch. The displaced couple now camps along the road, and the watch is one of the few pieces of their former life the outlaws have not ruined.

faq.q: Why is the pocket watch so important to Farmer Furlbrow?
aliases: why does furlbrow want his watch
faq.answer: Verna’s father gave the watch to Farmer Furlbrow on their wedding day. After the Defias Brotherhood took their land, home, and livelihood, it is the couple’s last deeply sentimental possession.

faq.q: Where is the pocket watch kept?
faq.answer: The watch is inside a wardrobe in the Furlbrow farmhouse, among the pumpkin fields west of the main road where the Furlbrows are stranded.
The Defias Brotherhood has taken over the farmhouse. Benny Blaanco and his cohort loiter near the wardrobe.

faq.q: Did the Defias steal the watch directly?
faq.answer: No. The Furlbrows fled in a panic when the bandits raided the pumpkin patch, and Farmer Furlbrow forgot to pack the watch. It remained in their bedroom wardrobe as the farm was overrun.

angles.text: Helping the Furlbrows recover their heirloom shows how completely the Stormwind crown has failed to protect Westfall’s hard-working farmers from organized banditry.
